title: Add Two and Square
prompt:
Write two global functions (use function declarations so they are available to the grader):

  • add_two(a, b) — return the sum of a and b
  • square(n) — return n times itself

After you Run, Grade will call your functions with random integers from 2 to 10 and check the return values.

html.starter: Implement add_two and square in the JavaScript tab, then Run and Grade.

tests.name: add_two returns the sum
tests.feedback: Define function add_two(a, b) { return a + b; }

tests.name: square returns n * n
tests.feedback: Define function square(n) { return n * n; }
